method: Three bounded read-only Firecrawl landing-page scrapes. No interaction, authentication, form submission, applicant-data collection, provider contact, or follow-on crawl occurred.
limitations: Each observation proves only what the named public URL returned in this bounded scrape. These are current acquisition-architecture observations, not completeness proofs or accepted scholarship facts.

observations.observed: The returned landing page stated that it presents three primary scholarship opportunities and that one unified application form serves them.

The returned slice exposed 50 distinct opportunity links, visible Page 1 through Page 4 labels, and a Next link carrying page=2. The remaining catalog denominator was not crawled and is unknown from this one-page probe.
The returned landing page routed discovery to Pearson Futures and stated that individual scholarship providers fund and administer awards with distinct terms and application processes.
